text:
maria: quick q — contract clause requires feature X to be gated per-customer for enterprise accounts (acme-corp + similar). can we enable a per-customer flag for this and outline guardrails?

sam: yes. plan sketch below. want signoff before I start implementation.

aj: thanks for flagging. do we have a list of account IDs and which ones are VIP that need manual opt-in?

luis: i have the list — VIPs: acct_102, acct_219, acct_314. acme-corp is acct_102 so manual only.

sam: proposed approach:
- create a feature flag scoped by account id: feature.enterprise.contract_gated.<contract_id_or_acct_id>
- default = off, explicit allowlist for accounts with contract clause
- canary rollout for new contracts = 5% of accounts in same tier (non-VIP)
- VIP accounts are excluded from auto-canary; require product + legal signoff to flip
- automated guardrails: monitor error rate, avg latency, token cost delta; rollback if any exceed thresholds

maria: what thresholds do you propose?

sam: starting thresholds:
- error rate increase > 0.5% absolute over baseline for 10m -> rollback
- p50 latency increase > 150ms or p95 > 400ms for 5m -> rollback
- token cost delta > 20% for 1h -> alert + manual review

aj: sounds reasonable. how will ops flip the flag? UI + CLI? need audit trail.

sam: both. implementation notes: use flag-service allowlists stored as contract metadata. admin UI for manual flips with a required reason field. CLI example:
```
# add acme-corp to allowlist for feature X
flagctl allow add --feature feature.enterprise.contract_gated --account acct_102 --reason "contract clause 42 - acme onboarding"
# start canary for feature id f_123
flagctl rollout start --feature f_123 --percent 5 --scope tier:enterprise --skip-vips
```

luis: audit logs should include who toggled, IP, and deploy id. can we attach the current git sha for the change too?

sam: yes. flag-service will log actor, timestamp, reason, git_sha (if provided). infra-bot will capture deploy metadata when rollout starts.

deploy-bot: rollout detected: feature f_123 started canary at 5% (initiated by sam). monitoring hooks attached.

maria: what about fallback behavior if the flagged code path fails? default to previous stable behavior, not feature X. no surprise behavior for VIPs.

sam: agreed. fallback = stable path. also add soft quota per-account to limit token spend while canary is running (protect billing).

aj: owner assignments?
- sam: implementation (flag-service + admin UI)
- luis: account mapping + VIP list verification
- maria: product + legal signoff for VIPs
- aj: rollout monitoring + post-canary quality checks

maria: timeline?

sam: prototype in 2d, internal review day 3, canary ready by EOW if no blockers.

luis: i'll validate VIP list today and DM sam the final IDs.

infra-bot: note: make sure to include canary attribution headers for tracing (x-rw-canary: true/false).

aj: one more: add a small smoke test run against a sandbox account that mimics acme corp traffic before flipping.

sam: will add. smoke tests: 200 requests with typical prompt distribution, assert p95 latency < 350ms and error rate < 0.2%.

maria: perfect. please post PR and link when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: will do — PR up later today and ping for review.

deploy-bot: alert: flag change pending review (PR #5123).
